title: AI may help, but it’s no substitute for sturdy cyber defence | The Strategist
paragraphs: Sprinkling AI pixie dust around the place doesn’t automatically provide cyber defence. In its Annual Cyber Threat Report 2025–26, the Australian Signal Directorate urges organisations to embrace AI for cyber defence, but asking how much AI your cyber team is using is asking the wrong question.
No AI product makes up for not knowing what software you run, which of it is out of date, or what data you have needlessly exposed to the internet.

The ASD responded to more than 1,500 incidents last year, up more than 20 percent on the previous year, as attackers used automation to exploit known weaknesses faster than poorly managed organisations can fix them.
